label: colorClamps: the shared converter drops the clamp
kernelColor scales by the wrong range
scrubKeepsDrag: a colour or width scrub's sample lands as a whole edit
oneStepForSeveral: each selected layer's stroke is its own undo step
find: for id in ids { _ = pages.update(id) { $0.stroke = stroke } }
replace: for id in ids { let one = snapshot; _ = pages.update(id) { $0.stroke = stroke }; record(name, before: one) }

label: lockedSkipped: a locked layer in the selection takes the stroke
widthClamps: the editor's over-range width goes to the kernel unclamped
hiddenRefuses: a hidden layer in the selection leaves the stroke editor enabled
find: guard let hidden = strokeIDs.first(where: isHiddenInTree) else { return nil }
replace: guard let hidden = Optional<String>.none else { return nil }

label: inspectorSkipsLocked: the inspector's stroke reaches a locked layer, so LiveStyling refuses it
inspectorKeepsSelection: the inspector's stroke drops the skipped locked layer from the selection
